paragraphs: If you're ready to close or exit your business in SAIF, we make the entire liquidation process easy, legal, and painless.
We clear outstanding bills, cancel employee visas, follow all offboarding procedures, and deactivate your business license with SAIF authorities.
We also handle asset transfers, final audits, and obtaining all necessary No Objection Certificates (NOCs) — so you can exit your business with full confidence.

items.q: What is the procedure to register a new company in SAIF Free Zone?
items.a: Select a license (commercial, service, industrial, or e-commerce), choose your business activity, reserve a company name, submit documents, secure your visa and establishment card, and lease an office or warehouse. We handle all these steps for you.

items.q: How long does registering a company in SAIF Zone take?
items.a: SAIF Free Zone offers same-day registration with instant license approval. Typically, the full setup completes in 2-5 business days.

items.q: What types of Business Licenses are available in SAIF Zone?
items.a: Commercial, Service, Industrial, E-Commerce licenses, plus Freelance & Startup permits — each tailored to different business activities.

items.q: Can I legally have 100% ownership of my SAIF company as a foreigner?
items.a: Yes. SAIF Free Zone allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: Which tax advantages can you experience within SAIF Free Zone?
items.a: Zero personal and corporate income tax, no customs duty on imports and exports, and full repatriation of profits.

items.q: What type of facilities are offered in the SAIF Free Zone?
items.a: Ready-to-use office spaces, light industrial units, warehousing, and customizable industrial land plots.

items.q: Is SAIF Free Zone a good option for logistics and/or manufacturing companies?
items.a: Absolutely. SAIF is next to Sharjah International Airport with direct access to major highways and seaports — ideal for logistics, distribution, freight forwarding, manufacturing, and assembly.

items.q: Is it possible to get help with SAIF visa services?
items.a: Yes. We handle investor visas, employee visas, family sponsorship, Emirates ID, medicals, and renewals.

items.q: What compliance services do SAIF companies require?
items.a: UBO reporting, ESR filings, AML compliance, license renewals, and ongoing regulatory monitoring.
